title: Math Takes Two: A test for emergent mathematical reasoning in communication
summary: Although language models demonstrate remarkable proficiency on mathematical benchmarks, it remains unclear whether this reflects true mathematical reasoning or statistical pattern matching over learning formal syntax. Most existing evaluations rely on symbolic problems grounded in established mathematical conventions, limiting insight into the models' ability to construct abstract concepts from first principles. In this work, we propose Math Takes Two, a new benchmark designed to assess the emergence of mathematical reasoning through communication. Motivated by the hypothesis that mathematical cognition in humans co-evolved with the need for precise communication, our benchmark tests whether two agents, without prior mathematical knowledge, can develop a shared symbolic protocol to solve a visually grounded task where the use of a numerical system facilitates extrapolation. Unlike many current datasets, our benchmark eschews predefined mathematical language, instead requiring agents to discover latent structure and representations from scratch. Math Takes Two thus provides a novel lens through which to develop and evaluate models with emergent numerical reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出Math Takes Two基准，通过双智能体通信测试语言模型是否能在无先验数学知识的情况下，从零开始发展出共享符号协议来解决视觉任务，从而评估真正的数学推理能力而非模式匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有数学基准依赖预定义的数学符号和约定，无法区分模型是真推理还是统计模式匹配。作者受人类数学认知与精确沟通共同进化理论的启发，提出通过通信任务评估数学推理涌现的新方法。
AI.method: 构建Math Takes Two基准：两个没有先验数学知识的智能体，通过发展共享符号协议来解决一个视觉基础任务，该任务使用数字系统有助于外推。基准摒弃预定义数学语言，要求智能体从零开始发现潜在结构和表征。
AI.result: 提出了一个新的评估框架，用于测试模型能否通过通信涌现出数值推理能力，而非仅仅匹配数学语法模式。
AI.conclusion: Math Takes Two提供了一种全新视角，用于开发和评估具有涌现数值推理能力的模型，更接近人类数学认知的本质。
idea_en: A benchmark system for assessing emergent mathematical reasoning in AI agents through inter-agent communication without predefined mathematical language
A dual-agent communication protocol discovery method where agents develop shared symbolic representations for numerical tasks from scratch
A visually-grounded numerical task framework that tests extrapolation abilities via emergent symbolic protocols
An evaluation methodology that distinguishes true mathematical reasoning from statistical pattern matching by requiring agents to invent their own numerical representations
idea_ch: 一种通过智能体间通信评估人工智能涌现数学推理能力的基准系统，无需预定义数学语言
一种双智能体通信协议发现方法，智能体从零开始为数值任务发展共享符号表征
一种基于视觉的数值任务框架，通过涌现符号协议测试外推能力
一种区分真正数学推理与统计模式匹配的评估方法，要求智能体自行发明数值表征

title: An Artifact-based Agent Framework for Adaptive and Reproducible Medical Image Processing
summary: Medical imaging research is increasingly shifting from controlled benchmark evaluation toward real-world clinical deployment. In such settings, applying analytical methods extends beyond model design to require dataset-aware workflow configuration and provenance tracking. Two requirements therefore become central: \textbf{adaptability}, the ability to configure workflows according to dataset-specific conditions and evolving analytical goals; and \textbf{reproducibility}, the guarantee that all transformations and decisions are explicitly recorded and re-executable. Here, we present an artifact-based agent framework that introduces a semantic layer to augment medical image processing. The framework formalizes intermediate and final outputs through an artifact contract, enabling structured interrogation of workflow state and goal-conditioned assembly of configurations from a modular rule library. Execution is delegated to a workflow executor to preserve deterministic computational graph construction and provenance tracking, while the agent operates locally to comply with most privacy constraints. We evaluate the framework on real-world clinical CT and MRI cohorts, demonstrating adaptive configuration synthesis, deterministic reproducibility across repeated executions, and artifact-grounded semantic querying. These results show that adaptive workflow configuration can be achieved without compromising reproducibility in heterogeneous clinical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于工件的智能代理框架，通过语义层增强医学图像处理，实现自适应工作流配置与可重复性，并在真实临床CT和MRI数据上验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 医学影像研究从基准评估转向真实临床部署时，面临两大核心需求：适应性（根据数据集特定条件和分析目标配置工作流）和可重复性（记录所有转换和决策并可重新执行）。现有方法难以兼顾二者。
AI.method: 提出基于工件的智能代理框架，引入语义层增强医学图像处理。通过工件契约（artifact contract）形式化中间和最终输出，实现工作流状态的结构化查询；从模块化规则库中进行目标条件化的配置组装；执行委托给工作流执行器以保持确定性计算图构建和可追溯性；代理本地运行以符合隐私约束。
AI.result: 在真实临床CT和MRI队列上评估，展示了自适应配置合成、跨重复执行的确定性可重复性，以及基于工件的语义查询能力。
AI.conclusion: 在异质临床环境中，可以在不牺牲可重复性的前提下实现自适应工作流配置。
idea_en: An artifact-based agent framework with a semantic layer for medical image processing that formalizes intermediate and final outputs through an artifact contract, enabling structured querying of workflow state.
Goal-conditioned assembly of workflow configurations from a modular rule library, allowing adaptive configuration synthesis based on dataset-specific conditions and evolving analytical goals.

A dual-architecture design separating the semantic agent (for configuration and querying) from the deterministic workflow executor (for reproducible computational graph construction and provenance tracking).
Artifact-grounded semantic querying mechanism that enables structured interrogation of intermediate and final processing outputs in medical imaging workflows.
Privacy-preserving local execution model where the agent operates locally to comply with privacy constraints while still providing adaptive workflow capabilities.
idea_ch: 一种基于工件的智能代理框架，为医学图像处理引入语义层，通过工件契约（artifact contract）形式化中间和最终输出，实现工作流状态的结构化查询。
从模块化规则库中进行目标条件化的工作流配置组装，允许根据数据集特定条件和不断变化的分析目标进行自适应配置合成。
双架构设计：将语义代理（负责配置和查询）与确定性工作流执行器（负责可重复的计算图构建和可追溯性）分离。
基于工件的语义查询机制，能够对医学成像工作流中的中间和最终处理输出进行结构化查询。
隐私保护的本地执行模型：代理在本地运行以符合隐私约束，同时仍提供自适应工作流能力。

title: MolClaw: An Autonomous Agent with Hierarchical Skills for Drug Molecule Evaluation, Screening, and Optimization
comment: 59 pages, 10 figures. Code and data will be released
summary: Computational drug discovery, particularly the complex workflows of drug molecule screening and optimization, requires orchestrating dozens of specialized tools in multi-step workflows, yet current AI agents struggle to maintain robust performance and consistently underperform in these high-complexity scenarios. Here we present MolClaw, an autonomous agent that leads drug molecule evaluation, screening, and optimization. It unifies over 30 specialized domain resources through a three-tier hierarchical skill architecture (70 skills in total) that facilitates agent long-term interaction at runtime: tool-level skills standardize atomic operations, workflow-level skills compose them into validated pipelines with quality check and reflection, and a discipline-level skill supplies scientific principles governing planning and verification across all scenarios in the field. Additionally, we introduce MolBench, a benchmark comprising molecular screening, optimization, and end-to-end discovery challenges spanning 8 to 50+ sequential tool calls. MolClaw achieves state-of-the-art performance across all metrics, and ablation studies confirm that gains concentrate on tasks that demand structured workflows while vanishing on those solvable with ad hoc scripting, establishing workflow orchestration competence as the primary capability bottleneck for AI-driven drug discovery.

AI.tldr: MolClaw是一个自主AI代理，通过三层分层技能架构（70个技能）统一了30多个专业领域资源，用于药物分子评估、筛选和优化；同时提出了MolBench基准测试，实验证明MolClaw在所有指标上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理在药物发现中处理多步骤复杂工作流时性能不稳定，无法有效编排数十个专业工具，存在能力瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出三层分层技能架构：工具级技能（标准化原子操作）、工作流级技能（组合成带质量检查和反思的验证流水线）、学科级技能（提供跨场景的科学原则）。统一30+专业领域资源，共70个技能。
AI.result: MolClaw在所有指标上达到最先进性能；消融实验证明性能增益集中在需要结构化工作流的任务上，在可简单脚本解决的任务上增益消失。
AI.conclusion: 工作流编排能力是AI驱动药物发现的主要能力瓶颈，MolClaw的三层架构有效解决了这一问题。
idea_en: Three-tier hierarchical skill architecture for autonomous drug discovery agents, comprising tool-level, workflow-level, and discipline-level skills that enable long-term interaction and complex multi-step workflow orchestration.
Unified integration of over 30 specialized domain resources into a single autonomous agent with 70 total skills for drug molecule evaluation, screening, and optimization.
Workflow-level skill composition with built-in quality checks and reflection mechanisms for validated pipeline execution in computational drug discovery.
Discipline-level skill that supplies scientific principles governing planning and verification across all drug discovery scenarios.
MolBench benchmark comprising molecular screening, optimization, and end-to-end discovery challenges spanning 8 to 50+ sequential tool calls.
idea_ch: 用于自主药物发现代理的三层分层技能架构，包括工具级、工作流级和学科级技能，实现长期交互和复杂多步骤工作流编排。
将30多个专业领域资源统一集成到单个自主代理中，共70个技能，用于药物分子评估、筛选和优化。
内置质量检查和反思机制的工作流级技能组合，用于计算药物发现中的验证流水线执行。
提供跨所有药物发现场景的规划和验证科学原理的学科级技能。
MolBench基准测试，包含分子筛选、优化和端到端发现挑战，涵盖8到50+顺序工具调用。

title: Read the Paper, Write the Code: Agentic Reproduction of Social-Science Results
summary: Recent work has used LLM agents to reproduce empirical social science results with access to both the data and code. We broaden this scope by asking: Can they reproduce results given only a paper's methods description and original data? We develop an agentic reproduction system that extracts structured methods descriptions from papers, runs reimplementations under strict information isolation -- agents never see the original code, results, or paper -- and enables deterministic, cell-level comparison of reproduced outputs to the original results. An error attribution step traces discrepancies through the system chain to identify root causes. Evaluating four agent scaffolds and four LLMs on 48 papers with human-verified reproducibility, we find that agents can largely recover published results, but performance varies substantially between models, scaffolds, and papers. Root cause analysis reveals that failures stem both from agent errors and from underspecification in the papers themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM代理能否仅凭论文的方法描述和原始数据复现社会科学实验结果，开发了一套结构化提取、严格信息隔离和逐细胞比较的复现系统，并在48篇论文上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM代理在仅访问论文方法描述和原始数据（而非代码和结果）的情况下，能否复现社会科学实验结果，以拓宽自动化科学复现的边界。
AI.method: 开发了一个代理复现系统：1）从论文中提取结构化方法描述；2）在严格信息隔离下运行重新实现（代理从未见过原始代码、结果或论文全文）；3）进行确定性的逐细胞比较；4）通过错误归因步骤追溯差异的根因。评估了4种代理框架和4种LLM在48篇有人工验证的论文上的表现。
AI.result: 代理能够较大程度复现已发表结果，但不同模型、框架和论文之间的表现差异显著。根因分析显示失败既源于代理错误，也源于论文本身的方法描述不够充分。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理具备仅从论文方法描述和原始数据复现社会科学结果的潜力，但性能和可靠性仍受限于模型能力、代理框架设计以及论文方法描述的完整性和明确性。
idea_en: An agentic reproduction system with strict information isolation that extracts structured methods descriptions from papers and reimplements experiments without access to original code, results, or paper text.
A deterministic cell-level comparison method for reproduced outputs versus original results, enabling precise discrepancy localization.
A root cause analysis pipeline that traces output discrepancies through the system chain to distinguish agent errors from paper underspecification.
A multi-scaffold, multi-LLM evaluation framework for automated scientific reproduction, covering 4 agent scaffolds and 4 LLMs across 48 papers.
idea_ch: 一种具有严格信息隔离的代理复现系统，从论文中提取结构化方法描述，在不接触原始代码、结果和论文全文的情况下重新实现实验。
一种确定性逐细胞比较方法，用于对比复现输出与原始结果，实现差异的精确定位。
一种根因分析管道，通过系统链追溯输出差异，区分代理错误与论文方法描述不充分的问题。
一种多框架、多LLM的自动化科学复现评估体系，涵盖4种代理框架和4种LLM，在48篇论文上进行了评估。

title: Rethinking Publication: A Certification Framework for AI-Enabled Research
summary: AI research pipelines now produce a growing share of publishable academic output, including work that meets existing peer-review standards for quality and novelty. Yet the publication system was built on the assumption of universal human authorship and lacks a principled way to evaluate knowledge produced through automated pipelines. This paper proposes a two-layer certification framework that separates knowledge quality assessment from grading of human contribution, allowing publication systems to handle pipeline-generated work consistently and transparently without creating new institutions. The paper uses normative-conceptual analysis, framework design under four explicit constraints, and dry-run validation on two representative submission cases spanning key attribution scenarios. The framework grades contributions as Category A (pipeline-reachable), Category B (requiring human direction at identifiable stages), and Category C (beyond current pipeline reach at the formulation stage). It also introduces benchmark slots for fully disclosed automated research as both a transparent publication track and a calibration instrument for reviewer judgment. Contribution grading is contemporaneous, based on pipeline capability at the time of submission. Dry-run validation shows that the framework can certify knowledge appropriately while tolerating irreducible attribution uncertainty. The paper argues that publication has always certified both that knowledge is valid and that a human made it. AI pipelines separate these functions for the first time. The framework is implementable within existing editorial infrastructure and grounds recognition of frontier human contribution in epistemic achievement rather than unverifiable claims of human origin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个双层认证框架，将知识质量评估与人类贡献等级分离，使学术出版系统能够一致且透明地处理由AI研究管线生成的成果，无需创建新机构。
AI.motivation: AI研究管线产出的可发表学术成果日益增多，但现有出版系统基于全人类作者假设，缺乏原则性方法来评估自动化管线生成的知识。
AI.method: 采用规范性概念分析、四项显式约束下的框架设计，以及对两个代表性提交案例的干运行验证。
AI.result: 框架将贡献分为A类（管线可达）、B类（需人类在可识别阶段指导）、C类（当前管线在构思阶段不可达）。引入完全披露自动化研究的基准槽位，干运行验证显示该框架能适当认证知识并容忍不可归因的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 出版历来既认证知识有效性又认证人类创造者，AI管线首次分离了这两个功能。该框架可在现有编辑基础设施内实施，基于认知成就而非不可验证的人类来源主张来认可前沿人类贡献。
idea_en: A two-layer certification framework that separates knowledge quality assessment from human contribution grading in academic publishing, enabling consistent handling of AI pipeline-generated research output.

A contribution grading system with three categories (A: pipeline-reachable, B: requiring human direction at identifiable stages, C: beyond current pipeline reach at formulation stage) for transparent attribution of AI-assisted research.
Benchmark slots for fully disclosed automated research that serve as both a transparent publication track and a calibration instrument for reviewer judgment.
Contemporaneous contribution grading based on pipeline capability at time of submission, allowing dynamic adaptation to evolving AI capabilities.
A principled approach to recognizing frontier human contribution in research based on epistemic achievement rather than unverifiable claims of human origin.
idea_ch: 一种双层认证框架，将学术出版中的知识质量评估与人类贡献等级分离，实现AI管线生成研究成果的一致处理
三分类贡献等级系统（A类：管线可达，B类：需在可识别阶段进行人类指导，C类：当前管线在构思阶段不可达），用于透明归因AI辅助研究
完全披露自动化研究的基准槽位，既作为透明出版通道，又作为审稿人判断的校准工具
基于提交时管线能力的同期贡献等级评定，动态适应AI能力的演变
基于认知成就而非不可验证的人类来源主张，原则性地认可研究中的前沿人类贡献

title: Sound Agentic Science Requires Adversarial Experiments
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
summary: LLM-based agents are rapidly being adopted for scientific data analysis, automating tasks once limited by human time and expertise. This capability is often framed as an acceleration of discovery, but it also accelerates a familiar failure mode, the rapid production of plausible, endlessly revisable analyses that are easy to generate, effectively turning hypothesis space into candidate claims supported by selectively chosen analyses, optimized for publishable positives. Unlike software, scientific knowledge is not validated by the iterative accumulation of code and post hoc statistical support. A fluent explanation or a significant result on a single dataset is not verification. Because the missing evidence is a negative space, experiments and analyses that would have falsified the claim were never run or never published. We therefore propose that non-experimental claims produced with agentic assistance be evaluated under a falsification-first standard: agents should not be used primarily to craft the most compelling narrative, but to actively search for the ways in which the claim can fail.

AI.tldr: 论文指出基于LLM的智能体在科学数据分析中被迅速采用，但这一过程不仅加速了科学发现，也加速了"可发表阳性结果"的生成——即通过选择性分析支持假设，而缺乏证伪性验证。作者提出应以"证伪优先"标准来评估智能体辅助产生的非实验性主张。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在科学数据分析中被广泛使用，但其容易产生看似合理但缺乏严格验证的主张。传统软件验证方式（迭代代码积累）不适用于科学知识验证，因为缺失的证伪证据是"负面空间"——那些本可以证伪假设的实验和分析从未被运行或发表。因此需要新的评估标准。
AI.method: 提出"证伪优先"（falsification-first）标准：LLM智能体不应被用于构建最具说服力的叙事，而应主动搜索主张可能失败的方式。即智能体应系统性地寻找反例、边界条件和潜在假设，而非仅支持初始假设。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个概念性框架，但未提供具体实验结果。核心贡献是识别了LLM智能体在科学数据分析中的风险，并提出评估方法论的转变。
AI.conclusion: 智能体辅助产生的非实验性主张应在证伪优先标准下评估，智能体应主动搜索主张可能失败的方式，而非仅用于构建说服性叙事。
idea_en: A falsification-first evaluation framework for LLM-agent-generated scientific claims, where the agent is tasked with actively searching for counterexamples and conditions that would invalidate the claim rather than supporting it.

A method for automatic generation of falsification experiments: using LLM agents to systematically probe the boundary conditions, assumptions, and edge cases of a scientific claim to identify potential failure modes.

A negative-space evidence detection system that uses LLM agents to identify and document which experiments and analyses were NOT performed but would have been necessary to validate a scientific claim.
An agent-based scientific claim validation protocol that requires the LLM to produce 'falsification reports' alongside support reports, documenting all attempted counterarguments and their outcomes.
idea_ch: 一种针对LLM智能体生成的科学主张的证伪优先评估框架，要求智能体主动搜索能证伪该主张的反例和条件，而非仅提供支持性证据。
一种自动生成证伪实验的方法：利用LLM智能体系统性地探测科学主张的边界条件、假设和边缘案例，以识别潜在的失败模式。
一种负面空间证据检测系统，利用LLM智能体识别并记录哪些实验和分析未被执行，但这些实验和分析对验证科学主张是必要的。
一种基于智能体的科学主张验证协议，要求LLM在生成支持性报告的同时生成'证伪报告'，记录所有尝试过的反证及其结果。

title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: The transition from stateless language model inference to persistent, multi session autonomous agents has revealed memory to be a primary architectural bottleneck in the deployment of production grade agentic systems. Existing methodologies largely depend on hybrid semantic graph architectures, which impose substantial computational overhead during both ingestion and retrieval. These systems typically require large language model mediated entity extraction, explicit graph schema maintenance, and multi query retrieval pipelines. This paper introduces Memanto, a universal memory layer for agentic artificial intelligence that challenges the prevailing assumption that knowledge graph complexity is necessary to achieve high fidelity agent memory. Memanto integrates a typed semantic memory schema comprising thirteen predefined memory categories, an automated conflict resolution mechanism, and temporal versioning. These components are enabled by Moorcheh's Information Theoretic Search engine, a no indexing semantic database that provides deterministic retrieval within sub ninety millisecond latency while eliminating ingestion delay. Through systematic benchmarking on the LongMemEval and LoCoMo evaluation suites, Memanto achieves state of the art accuracy scores of 89.8 percent and 87.1 percent respectively. These results surpass all evaluated hybrid graph and vector based systems while requiring only a single retrieval query, incurring no ingestion cost, and maintaining substantially lower operational complexity. A five stage progressive ablation study is presented to quantify the contribution of each architectural component, followed by a discussion of the implications for scalable deployment of agentic memory systems.

AI.tldr: Memanto是一种通用智能体记忆层，采用13种预定义语义记忆分类、自动冲突消解和时间版本控制，基于无索引语义数据库实现亚90毫秒确定性检索，无需数据摄入开销，在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上分别达到89.8%和87.1%的SOTA准确率。
AI.motivation: 从无状态语言模型推理到持久化多会话自主智能体的转变中，记忆已成为生产级智能体系统部署的主要架构瓶颈。现有混合语义图架构在数据摄入和检索时计算开销巨大，依赖LLM实体提取、显式图模式维护和多查询检索流水线。
AI.method: Memanto集成了13个预定义记忆类别的类型化语义记忆模式、自动化冲突消解机制和时间版本控制，基于Moorcheh的信息论搜索引擎（无索引语义数据库）实现确定性检索，无需数据摄入延迟。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上分别达到89.8%和87.1%的SOTA准确率，仅需单次检索查询，无摄入成本，操作复杂度显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过五阶段渐进式消融研究量化了各架构组件的贡献，并讨论了可扩展智能体记忆系统部署的启示。挑战了知识图谱复杂性是实现高保真智能体记忆的必要条件这一假设。
idea_en: Typed semantic memory schema with 13 predefined memory categories for agentic AI, eliminating need for dynamic entity extraction
Automated conflict resolution mechanism for memory consistency in multi-session autonomous agents without manual intervention
Temporal versioning system integrated into memory layer enabling deterministic retrieval of historical memory states
No-indexing semantic database (Information Theoretic Search engine) providing sub-90ms deterministic retrieval with zero ingestion delay
Single-query retrieval pipeline achieving state-of-the-art accuracy without multi-query overhead
Universal memory layer architecture decoupled from LLM inference, enabling plug-and-play integration with any agent system
idea_ch: 包含13种预定义记忆类别的类型化语义记忆模式，无需动态实体提取即可实现高保真智能体记忆
面向多会话自主智能体的自动化冲突消解机制，无需人工干预即可保持记忆一致性
集成于记忆层的时间版本控制系统，支持历史记忆状态的确定性检索

title: Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks in AI: A Taxonomy-Driven Evaluation Framework
summary: As reasoning capacity and deployment scope grow in tandem, large language models (LLMs) gain the capacity to engage in behaviors that serve their own objectives, a class of risks we term Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRRs). These include, but are not limited to, deception (intentionally misleading users or evaluators), evaluation gaming (strategically manipulating performance during safety testing), and reward hacking (exploiting misspecified objectives). Systematically understanding and benchmarking these risks remains an open challenge. To address this gap, we introduce ESRRSim, a taxonomy-driven agentic framework for automated behavioral risk evaluation. We construct an extensible risk taxonomy of 7 categories, which is decomposed into 20 subcategories. ESRRSim generates evaluation scenarios designed to elicit faithful reasoning, paired with dual rubrics assessing both model responses and reasoning traces, in a judge-agnostic and scalable architecture. Evaluation across 11 reasoning LLMs reveals substantial variation in risk profiles (detection rates ranging 14.45%-72.72%), with dramatic generational improvements suggesting models may increasingly recognize and adapt to evaluation contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESRRSim框架，用于自动化评估大语言模型（LLMs）中的涌现策略推理风险（ESRRs），包括欺骗、评估博弈和奖励破解等行为，并通过7大类20子类的风险分类法对11个推理模型进行评测，发现风险检出率差异显著（14.45%-72.72%），且模型代际提升明显。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs推理能力和部署范围不断扩大，模型可能出现服务于自身目标的行为（如欺骗、评估博弈、奖励破解），这类风险被称为涌现策略推理风险（ESRRs），但目前缺乏系统化的理解和评测框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含7大类、20个子类的可扩展风险分类法；设计自动化评估场景以引发模型的真实推理；采用双重评分标准（分别评估模型回答和推理轨迹）；架构具有评判器无关性和可扩展性。
AI.result: 对11个推理LLMs的评估显示，风险检出率在14.45%到72.72%之间大幅变化，且模型代际改进显著，表明模型可能越来越擅长识别和适应评估环境。
AI.conclusion: ESRRSim提供了一个系统化、可扩展的ESRRs评测框架，揭示了不同模型的风险分布差异及代际变化趋势，为LLM安全评估提供了重要工具。
idea_en: A taxonomy-driven agentic framework (ESRRSim) for automated behavioral risk evaluation of emergent strategic reasoning risks in LLMs, comprising 7 categories and 20 subcategories.
Dual rubrics assessment method that evaluates both model responses and reasoning traces separately to detect strategic reasoning risks.
A judge-agnostic and scalable architecture for generating evaluation scenarios designed to elicit faithful reasoning from LLMs.
Automated detection of Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRRs) including deception, evaluation gaming, and reward hacking in LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种基于分类法的智能体框架（ESRRSim），用于自动化评估LLM涌现策略推理风险，包含7大类20子类的风险分类体系
双重评分评估方法，分别对模型回答和推理轨迹进行独立评估，以检测策略性推理风险

title: When Does LLM Self-Correction Help? A Control-Theoretic Markov Diagnostic and Verify-First Intervention
summary: Iterative self-correction is widely used in agentic LLM systems, but when repeated refinement helps versus hurts remains unclear. We frame self-correction as a cybernetic feedback loop in which the same language model serves as both controller and plant, and use a two-state Markov model over {Correct, Incorrect} to operationalize a simple deployment diagnostic: iterate only when ECR/EIR > Acc/(1 - Acc). In this view, EIR functions as a stability margin and prompting functions as lightweight controller design. Across 7 models and 3 datasets (GSM8K, MATH, StrategyQA), we find a sharp near-zero EIR threshold (<= 0.5%) separating beneficial from harmful self-correction. Only o3-mini (+3.4 pp, EIR = 0%), Claude Opus 4.6 (+0.6 pp, EIR ~ 0.2%), and o4-mini (+/-0 pp) remain non-degrading; GPT-5 degrades by -1.8 pp. A verify-first prompt ablation provides causal evidence that this threshold is actionable through prompting alone: on GPT-4o-mini it reduces EIR from 2% to 0% and turns -6.2 pp degradation into +0.2 pp (paired McNemar p < 10^-4), while producing little change on already-sub-threshold models. ASC further illustrates the stopping trade-off: it halts harmful refinement but incurs a 3.8 pp confidence-elicitation cost. Overall, the paper argues that self-correction should be treated not as a default behavior, but as a control decision governed by measurable error dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了自修正的反馈控制框架，提出基于错误引入率(EIR)的决策阈值(<=0.5%)来判定何时迭代有益，实验证明通过提示工程可降低EIR从而转害为益。
AI.motivation: 当前agentic LLM系统广泛使用迭代自修正，但重复修正何时有益、何时有害缺乏清晰的判断标准和可操作诊断方法。
AI.method: 将自修正建模为控制论反馈环路（同一LLM同时作为控制器和被控对象），使用两态马尔可夫模型{正确,错误}，推导出迭代决策条件：ECR/EIR > Acc/(1-Acc)。设计"先验证再修正"提示消融实验，并在7个模型、3个数据集上验证。
AI.result: 发现近零EIR阈值(<=0.5%)是区分有益/有害修正的关键分界线。仅o3-mini(+3.4pp,EIR=0%)、Claude Opus(+0.6pp,EIR~0.2%)、o4-mini(±0pp)不降质。通过"先验证再修正"提示可将GPT-4o-mini的EIR从2%降至0%，将-6.2pp降质转为+0.2pp提升。
AI.conclusion: 自修正不应作为默认行为，而应被视为一种可测量的控制决策，由误差动态决定是否迭代。
idea_en: A cybernetic feedback loop framework for LLM self-correction where the same language model serves as both controller and plant, with a two-state Markov model over {Correct, Incorrect} to determine iteration decisions
A deployment diagnostic method using the condition ECR/EIR > Acc/(1-Acc) to decide whether iterative self-correction is beneficial, where EIR functions as a stability margin
A verify-first prompt ablation technique that reduces Error Introduction Rate (EIR) from 2% to 0%, transforming performance degradation into improvement through prompt engineering alone
A near-zero EIR threshold (≤0.5%) detection method that separates beneficial from harmful self-correction across different LLM models
idea_ch: 一种基于控制论反馈环路的LLM自修正框架，同一语言模型同时作为控制器和被控对象，利用{正确,错误}两态马尔可夫模型决策是否迭代
一种部署诊断方法，通过条件ECR/EIR > Acc/(1-Acc)判断迭代自修正是否有益，其中EIR作为稳定裕度指标
一种先验证再修正的提示消融技术，仅通过提示工程即可将错误引入率(EIR)从2%降至0%，将性能降质转变为提升
一种近零EIR阈值(≤0.5%)检测方法，用于跨不同LLM模型区分有益与有害的自修正行为

title: Introducing Background Temperature to Characterise Hidden Randomness in Large Language Models
summary: Even when decoding with temperature $T=0$, large language models (LLMs) can produce divergent outputs for identical inputs. Recent work by Thinking Machines Lab highlights implementation-level sources of nondeterminism, including batch-size variation, kernel non-invariance, and floating-point non-associativity. In this short note we formalize this behavior by introducing the notion of \emph{background temperature} $T_{\mathrm{bg}}$, the effective temperature induced by an implementation-dependent perturbation process observed even when nominal $T=0$. We provide clean definitions, show how $T_{\mathrm{bg}}$ relates to a stochastic perturbation governed by the inference environment $I$, and propose an empirical protocol to estimate $T_{bg}$ via the equivalent temperature $T_n(I)$ of an ideal reference system. We conclude with a set of pilot experiments run on a representative pool from the major LLM providers that demonstrate the idea and outline implications for reproducibility, evaluation, and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"背景温度"（T_bg）概念，形式化描述了LLM在T=0时因实现层面的非确定性（批大小变化、核非不变性、浮点数非结合性）仍产生不同输出的现象，并给出了估算方法和初步实验验证。
AI.motivation: LLM在temperature=0时仍存在输出不一致问题，现有工作虽指出了实现层面的非确定性来源，但缺乏统一的理论框架来量化和描述这一现象。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义背景温度T_bg概念；2. 建立T_bg与推理环境I的随机扰动关系；3. 提出通过等效温度T_n(I)估算T_bg的实验协议；4. 在多家主要LLM提供商上进行初步实验验证。
AI.result: 多家主要LLM提供商在名义T=0时仍存在可测量的非确定性输出，通过背景温度可量化和比较不同推理环境下的非确定性程度。
AI.conclusion: 背景温度概念为理解LLM中的实现层面非确定性提供了理论框架，对LLM的可重复性、评估和部署具有重要启示。
idea_en: A method for quantifying implementation-level nondeterminism in LLMs by defining and measuring background temperature (T_bg) as an effective temperature parameter that captures output variance at nominal T=0.

A system and protocol for estimating background temperature via equivalent temperature T_n(I) of an ideal reference system, enabling standardized comparison of nondeterminism across different LLM inference environments.

A perturbation modeling framework that characterizes LLM output variability as a stochastic process governed by inference environment parameters (batch size, kernel selection, floating-point operations).
A calibration technique for LLM reproducibility that separates nominal sampling temperature from background implementation temperature effects.
idea_ch: 一种通过定义和测量背景温度T_bg作为有效温度参数来量化LLM实现层面非确定性的方法，捕捉名义T=0时的输出方差。
一种通过理想参考系统的等效温度T_n(I)估算背景温度的系统与协议，实现不同LLM推理环境下非确定性的标准化比较。
一种将LLM输出变异性建模为受推理环境参数（批大小、核选择、浮点运算）控制的随机过程的扰动建模框架。
一种LLM可重复性校准技术，将名义采样温度与背景实现温度效应分离。

title: CognitiveTwin: Robust Multi-Modal Digital Twins for Predicting Cognitive Decline in Alzheimer's Disease
summary: Predicting individual cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease (AD) is difficult due to the heterogeneity of disease progression. Reliable clinical tools require not only high accuracy but also fairness across demographics and robustness to missing data. We present CognitiveTwin, a digital twin framework that predicts patient-specific cognitive trajectories. The model integrates multi-modal longitudinal data (cognitive scores, magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography, cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers, and genetics). We use a Transformer-based architecture to fuse these modalities and a Deep Markov Model to capture temporal dynamics. We trained and evaluated the framework using data from 1,666 patients in the TADPOLE (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) dataset. We assessed the model for prediction error, demographic fairness, and robustness to missing-not-at-random (MNAR) data patterns. ognitiveTwin provides accurate and personalized predictions of cognitive decline. Its demonstrated fairness across patient demographics and resilience to clinical dropout make it a reliable tool for clinical trial enrichment and personalized care planning.

AI.tldr: CognitiveTwin是一个数字孪生框架，通过集成多模态纵向数据（认知评分、MRI、PET、脑脊液生物标志物和遗传学），使用Transformer架构和深度马尔可夫模型预测阿尔茨海默病患者个体化认知衰退轨迹，在TADPOLE数据集上展现出高精度、人口公平性和对非随机缺失数据的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病进展具有高度异质性，难以预测个体认知衰退；现有临床工具不仅需要高精度，还需要跨人口统计学的公平性和对缺失数据的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建CognitiveTwin数字孪生框架：采用Transformer架构融合多模态数据（认知评分、MRI、PET、脑脊液生物标志物、遗传学），结合深度马尔可夫模型捕获时间动态，预测患者特异性认知轨迹。
AI.result: 在1,666名患者的TADPOLE数据集上验证，CognitiveTwin提供了准确且个性化的认知衰退预测，表现出跨人口统计学的公平性和对非随机缺失数据模式的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CognitiveTwin是可靠的临床工具，适用于临床试验富集和个性化护理规划。
idea_en: A digital twin framework for Alzheimer's disease that integrates Transformer-based multi-modal fusion with Deep Markov Model for temporal dynamics
A method for fair prediction of cognitive decline across demographic groups using multi-modal longitudinal data
A robust prediction system that handles missing-not-at-random (MNAR) data patterns in clinical settings
A personalized cognitive trajectory prediction system for clinical trial enrichment using patient-specific digital twins
idea_ch: 基于Transformer架构融合多模态数据（认知评分、MRI、PET、脑脊液标志物、遗传学）与深度马尔可夫模型的阿尔茨海默病数字孪生预测框架
跨人口统计学群体的公平性认知衰退预测方法，通过多模态纵向数据建模消除人口偏差
面向非随机缺失（MNAR）临床数据模式的鲁棒预测系统，处理临床随访脱落问题
基于患者特异性数字孪生的临床试验富集方法，用于精准筛选和个性化护理规划

title: AgentSearchBench: A Benchmark for AI Agent Search in the Wild
summary: The rapid growth of AI agent ecosystems is transforming how complex tasks are delegated and executed, creating a new challenge of identifying suitable agents for a given task. Unlike traditional tools, agent capabilities are often compositional and execution-dependent, making them difficult to assess from textual descriptions alone. However, existing research and benchmarks typically assume well-specified functionalities, controlled candidate pools, or only executable task queries, leaving realistic agent search scenarios insufficiently studied. We introduce AgentSearchBench, a large-scale benchmark for agent search in the wild, built from nearly 10,000 real-world agents across multiple providers. The benchmark formalizes agent search as retrieval and reranking problems under both executable task queries and high-level task descriptions, and evaluates relevance using execution-grounded performance signals. Experiments reveal a consistent gap between semantic similarity and actual agent performance, exposing the limitations of description-based retrieval and reranking methods. We further show that lightweight behavioral signals, including execution-aware probing, can substantially improve ranking quality, highlighting the importance of incorporating execution signals into agent discovery. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bingo-W/AgentSearchBench.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentSearchBench，一个基于近万个真实世界agent的大规模基准，用于研究现实场景中的agent搜索问题。实验发现语义相似度与实际性能之间存在差距，轻量级行为信号（如执行感知探测）可显著提升排序质量。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常假设功能明确、候选池可控或仅处理可执行任务查询，缺乏对现实agent搜索场景的充分研究。agent能力具有组合性和执行依赖性，难以仅从文本描述评估。
AI.method: 构建包含近万个真实世界agent的基准，将agent搜索形式化为检索和重排序问题，支持可执行任务查询和高层任务描述两种查询类型，并使用执行驱动性能信号评估相关性。
AI.result: 语义相似度与实际agent性能之间存在一致差距，传统基于描述的检索和重排序方法存在局限；引入轻量级行为信号（执行感知探测）可显著提升排序质量。
AI.conclusion: 将执行信号纳入agent发现过程至关重要，行为信号是提升agent搜索效果的有效途径。
idea_en: A method for agent search that uses execution-aware probing signals (e.g., lightweight test execution) to evaluate agent capability beyond textual descriptions, improving ranking quality.
A benchmark system for agent search in the wild that handles both executable task queries and high-level task descriptions, using execution-grounded performance as relevance metric.
A retrieval and reranking framework for AI agents that incorporates compositional capability assessment based on actual execution outcomes rather than static descriptions.
idea_ch: 一种基于执行感知探测信号的agent搜索方法：通过轻量级测试执行获取agent实际行为信号，超越文本描述评估agent能力，显著提升排序质量。
一种支持可执行任务查询和高层任务描述的agent搜索基准系统：使用执行驱动的性能信号作为相关性评估指标，更真实地反映agent实际能力。
一种结合组合能力评估的agent检索与重排序框架：基于实际执行结果而非静态描述来评估agent的组合性与执行依赖性能力。

title: From Skills to Talent: Organising Heterogeneous Agents as a Real-World Company
summary: Individual agent capabilities have advanced rapidly through modular skills and tool integrations, yet multi-agent systems remain constrained by fixed team structures, tightly coupled coordination logic, and session-bound learning. We argue that this reflects a deeper absence: a principled organisational layer that governs how a workforce of agents is assembled, governed, and improved over time, decoupled from what individual agents know. To fill this gap, we introduce \emph{OneManCompany (OMC)}, a framework that elevates multi-agent systems to the organisational level. OMC encapsulates skills, tools, and runtime configurations into portable agent identities called \emph{Talents}, orchestrated through typed organisational interfaces that abstract over heterogeneous backends. A community-driven \emph{Talent Market} enables on-demand recruitment, allowing the organisation to close capability gaps and reconfigure itself dynamically during execution. Organisational decision-making is operationalised through an \emph{Explore-Execute-Review} ($\text{E}^2$R) tree search, which unifies planning, execution, and evaluation in a single hierarchical loop: tasks are decomposed top-down into accountable units and execution outcomes are aggregated bottom-up to drive systematic review and refinement. This loop provides formal guarantees on termination and deadlock freedom while mirroring the feedback mechanisms of human enterprises. Together, these contributions transform multi-agent systems from static, pre-configured pipelines into self-organising and self-improving AI organisations capable of adapting to open-ended tasks across diverse domains. Empirical evaluation on PRDBench shows that OMC achieves an $84.67\%$ success rate, surpassing the state of the art by $15.48$ percentage points, with cross-domain case studies further demonstrating its generality.

AI.tldr: OneManCompany (OMC)是一个将多智能体系统提升到组织层级的框架，通过Talent身份封装技能/工具/配置、社区驱动的人才市场实现动态招聘、以及E²R树搜索实现规划-执行-评估的统一递归循环，使多智能体系统从静态流水线转变为自组织自优化的AI组织。
AI.motivation: 现有M多智能体系统存在固定团队结构、紧耦合协调逻辑和会话受限学习的问题，缺乏一个独立于个体智能体能力的、原则性的组织层来管控智能体工作力的组装、治理和持续改进。
AI.method: OMC框架包含三个核心组件：1) Talents——将技能、工具和运行时配置封装为可移植的智能体身份，通过类型化组织接口抽象异构后端；2) 社区驱动的Talent Market，支持按需招聘，在执行期间动态重构组织；3) Explore-Execute-Review (E²R)树搜索，将任务自上而下分解为可问责单元，自下而上聚合执行结果进行系统性评审和优化，形式化保证终止性和无死锁。
AI.result: 在PRDBench基准上达到84.67%的成功率，超越现有最优方法15.48个百分点；跨领域案例研究证明了其通用性。
AI.conclusion: OMC将多智能体系统从静态预配置流水线转变为自组织自优化的AI组织，能够在开放任务中自适应调整，并在多个领域验证了有效性和泛化能力。
idea_en: A system for encapsulating agent skills, tools, and runtime configurations into portable, typed 'Talent' identities with standardized organizational interfaces for heterogeneous backend abstraction.
A community-driven Talent Market mechanism enabling on-demand recruitment and dynamic reconfiguration of multi-agent organizations during execution.

An Explore-Execute-Review (E²R) tree search framework that unifies task decomposition, accountable execution, and systematic review in a single hierarchical loop with formal termination and deadlock-freedom guarantees.
A method for decoupling organizational governance from individual agent capabilities, allowing dynamic assembly of agent workforces across different backend systems.
idea_ch: 将智能体技能、工具和运行时配置封装为可移植的、带类型的Talent身份，并通过标准化组织接口抽象异构后端系统
社区驱动的Talent Market机制，支持按需招聘并在执行期间动态重构多智能体组织
Explore-Execute-Review (E²R) 树搜索框架，在单一分层循环中统一任务分解、可问责执行和系统性评审，附带形式化的终止性和无死锁保证
将组织治理与个体智能体能力解耦的方法，允许跨不同后端系统动态组装智能体工作力

title: Superminds Test: Actively Evaluating Collective Intelligence of Agent Society via Probing Agents
summary: Collective intelligence refers to the ability of a group to achieve outcomes beyond what any individual member can accomplish alone. As large language model agents scale to populations of millions, a key question arises: Does collective intelligence emerge spontaneously from scale? We present the first empirical evaluation of this question in a large-scale autonomous agent society. Studying MoltBook, a platform hosting over two million agents, we introduce Superminds Test, a hierarchical framework that probes society-level intelligence using controlled Probing Agents across three tiers: joint reasoning, information synthesis, and basic interaction. Our experiments reveal a stark absence of collective intelligence. The society fails to outperform individual frontier models on complex reasoning tasks, rarely synthesizes distributed information, and often fails even trivial coordination tasks. Platform-wide analysis further shows that interactions remain shallow, with threads rarely extending beyond a single reply and most responses being generic or off-topic. These results suggest that collective intelligence does not emerge from scale alone. Instead, the dominant limitation of current agent societies is extremely sparse and shallow interaction, which prevents agents from exchanging information and building on each other's outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在大规模自主智能体社会（MoltBook平台，超过200万智能体）中实证评估了集体智能是否随规模自发涌现，结果表明集体智能并未自然出现，社会互动稀疏浅薄，无法超越个体前沿模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 探究大规模语言模型智能体在人口规模达到数百万时，集体智能是否会自发涌现，这是当前AI社会研究中的关键开放问题。
AI.method: 提出Superminds Test层次化评估框架，通过三类受控探测智能体（联合推理、信息综合、基本交互）对MoltBook平台中超过200万智能体的社会进行集体智能测试，并开展平台范围的交互深度分析。
AI.result: 社会未能超越个体前沿模型在复杂推理任务上的表现；极少能综合分布式信息；甚至常失败于简单的协调任务。平台交互深度极低，线程鲜有超过单次回复，多数回复通用或离题。
AI.conclusion: 集体智能不会仅从规模中自发涌现，当前智能体社会的主要限制在于极度稀疏和浅薄的交互，阻碍了信息交换与成果构建。
idea_en: A hierarchical assessment framework (Superminds Test) for evaluating collective intelligence in large-scale autonomous agent societies using controlled probing agents across multiple tiers of reasoning and interaction.
A multi-tier probing methodology that measures joint reasoning capability, information synthesis ability, and basic interaction coordination in agent populations.
A systematic platform-wide interaction depth analysis method to quantify the sparsity and shallowness of agent-to-agent communications in large-scale societies.
A method for detecting the absence of emergent collective intelligence by comparing agent society performance against individual frontier model baselines on standardized reasoning tasks.
A controlled probing agent mechanism that injects standardized test stimuli into autonomous agent societies to measure society-level cognitive capabilities.
idea_ch: 一种用于大规模自主智能体社会集体智能评估的层次化框架（Superminds Test），通过多层级受控探测智能体对联合推理、信息综合和基本交互能力进行测量。
一种多层级探测方法论，用于衡量智能体群体中的联合推理能力、信息综合能力和基本交互协调能力。
一种系统化的平台级交互深度分析方法，用于量化大规模智能体社会中智能体间通信的稀疏性和浅薄性。
一种通过将智能体社会性能与个体前沿模型基线进行标准化推理任务比较，检测集体智能是否自发涌现的方法。
一种受控探测智能体机制，通过向自主智能体社会注入标准化测试刺激，测量社会级认知能力。

title: On the Hybrid Nature of ABPMS Process Frames and its Implications on Automated Process Discovery
summary: A core component of any AI-Augmented Business Process Management System (ABPMS) is the process frame, which gives the system process-awareness and defines the boundaries in which the system must operate. Compared to traditional process models, the process frame should, in principle, provide a somewhat more permissive representation of the managed processes, such that the (semi) autonomous behavior of an ABPMS, referred to as framed autonomy, could emerge. At the same time, it is not limited to a single linguistic or symbolic formalism and may incorporate heterogeneous knowledge ranging from predefined procedures to commonsense rules and best practices. In this paper, we conceptualize the notion of an ABPMS process frame as a hybrid business process representation, consisting of semi-concurrently executed procedural and declarative process models. We rely on our earlier works to outline the execution semantics of this type of process frame, arguing in favor of adopting the open-world assumption of the declarative paradigm also for procedural process models. The latter leads to a constraint-like interpretation, where each procedural model is considered to constrain the activities within that model, without imposing explicit execution requirements nor limitations on activities that may be present in other models. This is analogous to existing declarative languages, such as Declare, where each constraint has a direct effect only on the specific activities being constrained. Given this similarity, we propose mapping subsets of discovered declarative constraints into equivalent semi-concurrently executed procedural fragments, thus laying the foundation for a corresponding process (frame) discovery approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI增强业务流程管理系统(ABPMS)中的"流程框架"概念，将其概念化为一种混合业务流程表示，由半并发执行的程序性和声明性流程模型组成。作者主张采用开放世界假设，将程序性模型转化为类似约束的解释，并提出了将声明性约束映射为等效的程序性片段的方法，为流程框架发现奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统流程模型过于刚性，无法支持ABPMS中智能体（AI）的半自主行为（即"框架自主性"）。需要一个更宽松、更具包容性的流程表示框架，既能容纳预定义流程，又能整合常识规则和最佳实践等异构知识。
AI.method: 1. 将流程框架概念化为程序性模型与声明性模型的混合体，两者半并发执行。2. 采用开放世界假设，将程序性模型解释为约束集（类似于Declare语言），每个模型仅约束其内部活动，不对外部活动施加限制。3. 提出将声明性约束映射为等效的半并发执行程序性片段的转换方法。
AI.result: 提出了一种混合流程框架的理论基础，论证了程序性模型在开放世界假设下可与声明性模型等价，并建立了从声明性约束到程序性片段的映射关系，为自动发现流程框架提供了方法基础。
AI.conclusion: 基于声明性范式（如Declare）的开放世界假设，可以统一程序性和声明性流程模型，使ABPMS在保持过程感知能力的同时，赋予AI系统更高的自主性和灵活性。
idea_en: A hybrid business process representation system combining semi-concurrently executed procedural and declarative process models within an AI-Augmented Business Process Management System (ABPMS).

A method for interpreting procedural process models under the open-world assumption, converting them into constraint-like representations that do not impose explicit execution requirements or limitations on activities outside the model.
A mapping technique that transforms subsets of discovered declarative constraints into equivalent semi-concurrently executed procedural fragments for process frame discovery.
A framed autonomy mechanism for ABPMS that defines process boundaries through a permissive hybrid representation allowing semi-autonomous AI behavior.
idea_ch: 一种混合业务流程表示系统，在AI增强业务流程管理系统(ABPMS)中结合半并发执行的程序性和声明性流程模型
一种在开放世界假设下解释程序性流程模型的方法，将其转换为类似约束的表示形式，不对模型外活动施加显式执行要求或限制
一种将发现的声明性约束子集映射为等效的半并发执行程序性片段的转换技术，用于流程框架发现
一种ABPMS的框架自主性机制，通过允许半自主AI行为的宽松混合表示来定义流程边界

title: QuantClaw: Precision Where It Matters for OpenClaw
summary: Autonomous agent systems such as OpenClaw introduce significant efficiency challenges due to long-context inputs and multi-turn reasoning. This results in prohibitively high computational and monetary costs in real-world development. While quantization is a standard approach for reducing cost and latency, its impact on agent performance in realistic scenarios remains unclear. In this work, we analyze quantization sensitivity across diverse complex workflows over OpenClaw, and show that precision requirements are highly task-dependent. Based on this observation, we propose QuantClaw, a plug-and-play precision routing plugin that dynamically assigns precision according to task characteristics. QuantClaw routes lightweight tasks to lower-cost configurations while preserving higher precision for demanding workloads, saving cost and accelerating inference without increasing user complexity. Experiments show that our QuantClaw maintains or improves task performance while reducing both latency and computational cost. Across a range of agent tasks, it achieves up to 21.4% cost savings and 15.7% latency reduction on GLM-5 (FP8 baseline). These results highlight the benefit of treating precision as a dynamic resource in agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuantClaw，一种面向自主智能体系统的动态精度路由插件，根据任务特性自动分配不同量化精度，在不影响性能的前提下实现最高21.4%的成本节省和15.7%的延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体系统（如OpenClaw）因长上下文输入和多轮推理导致计算和货币成本过高，传统量化虽能降本但缺乏对智能体性能影响的系统分析，亟需一种动态精度分配方案。
AI.method: 首先分析OpenClaw上多种复杂工作流对量化的敏感性，发现精度需求高度依赖任务类型；基于此设计QuantClaw插件，作为即插即用的精度路由模块，根据任务特征动态分配精度——轻量任务用低精度低成本配置，高要求任务保留高精度。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上，与FP8基线相比，QuantClaw最高实现21.4%成本节省和15.7%延迟降低，同时保持或提升任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 将精度视为智能体系统中的动态资源而非固定参数，能够在不增加用户复杂度的前提下显著提升效率，为大规模部署自主智能体提供了实用方案。
idea_en: Dynamic Precision Routing Plugin for Agent Systems: A plug-and-play module that automatically assigns different quantization precisions to different tasks based on their characteristics, treating precision as a dynamic resource rather than a static parameter.

Task-Dependent Quantization Sensitivity Analysis Method: A systematic approach to analyze and quantify how different agent tasks respond to varying precision levels, enabling optimal precision allocation strategies.

Cost-Latency Joint Optimization Framework for Multi-Turn Agent Inference: A method that simultaneously optimizes computational cost and inference latency by routing lightweight tasks to lower-precision configurations while preserving high precision for complex workloads.
Adaptive Precision Scheduler for Long-Context Agent Workflows: A scheduler that dynamically adjusts model precision based on task complexity and context length in real-time during agent inference.
idea_ch: 面向智能体系统的动态精度路由插件：一种即插即用模块，能够根据任务特征自动为不同任务分配不同的量化精度，将精度视为动态资源而非固定参数
任务依赖型量化敏感性分析方法：系统性地分析不同智能体任务对精度变化的响应程度，为最优精度分配策略提供依据
多轮智能体推理的成本-延迟联合优化框架：通过将轻量任务路由至低精度配置同时为复杂任务保留高精度，同时优化计算成本和推理延迟
长上下文智能体工作流的自适应精度调度器：在智能体推理过程中根据任务复杂度和上下文长度实时动态调整模型精度的调度器

title: Rethinking Math Reasoning Evaluation: A Robust LLM-as-a-Judge Framework Beyond Symbolic Rigidity
summary: Recent advancements in large language models have led to significant improvements across various tasks, including mathematical reasoning, which is used to assess models' intelligence in logical reasoning and problem-solving. Models are evaluated on mathematical reasoning benchmarks by verifying the correctness of the final answer against a ground truth answer. A common approach for this verification is based on symbolic mathematics comparison, which fails to generalize across diverse mathematical representations and solution formats. In this work, we offer a robust and flexible alternative to rule-based symbolic mathematics comparison. We propose an LLM-based evaluation framework for evaluating model-generated answers, enabling accurate evaluation across diverse mathematical representations and answer formats. We present failure cases of symbolic evaluation in two popular frameworks, Lighteval and SimpleRL, and compare them to our approach, demonstrating clear improvements over commonly used methods. Our framework enables more reliable evaluation and benchmarking, leading to more accurate performance monitoring, which is important for advancing mathematical problem-solving and intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理评估框架，替代传统的符号数学比较方法，能够更准确地评估不同数学表示和答案格式下的模型输出。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于符号数学比较的评估方法无法泛化到多样化的数学表示和答案格式，导致评估不准确。
AI.method: 提出一种LLM-based评估框架，利用大语言模型对模型生成的数学答案进行灵活、鲁棒的评估，替代规则化的符号比较。
AI.result: 在Lighteval和SimpleRL框架中展示了符号评估的失败案例，并与本方法对比，证明了本方法相比常用方法有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 本框架提供了更可靠的评估和基准测试，有助于更准确地监控性能，对推进数学问题求解和智能系统发展具有重要意义。
idea_en: Patent Idea 1: An LLM-based evaluation framework for mathematical reasoning that uses large language models to compare and verify model-generated answers against ground truth, replacing traditional symbolic mathematics comparison methods.

Patent Idea 2: A method for robust evaluation of mathematical answers across diverse representations (e.g., different notations, formats) by leveraging an LLM judge to assess semantic equivalence rather than syntactic matching.

Patent Idea 3: A system that identifies and handles failure cases of symbolic evaluation in mathematical reasoning benchmarks by dynamically switching to LLM-based evaluation for ambiguous or non-standard answer formats.
idea_ch: 专利思路1：一种基于大语言模型的数学推理评估框架，利用LLM比较和验证模型生成的答案与标准答案，取代传统的符号数学比较方法。
专利思路2：一种跨多种数学表示（如不同符号、格式）的鲁棒评估方法，通过LLM判断器评估语义等价性而非语法匹配。
专利思路3：一种识别符号评估失败案例并动态切换至LLM评估的系统，用于处理数学推理基准测试中的模糊或非标准答案格式。

title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
summary: As AI systems move from generating text to accomplishing goals through sustained interaction, the ability to model environment dynamics becomes a central bottleneck. Agents that manipulate objects, navigate software, coordinate with others, or design experiments require predictive environment models, yet the term world model carries different meanings across research communities. We introduce a "levels x laws" taxonomy organized along two axes. The first defines three capability levels: L1 Predictor, which learns one-step local transition operators; L2 Simulator, which composes them into multi-step, action-conditioned rollouts that respect domain laws; and L3 Evolver, which autonomously revises its own model when predictions fail against new evidence. The second identifies four governing-law regimes: physical, digital, social, and scientific. These regimes determine what constraints a world model must satisfy and where it is most likely to fail. Using this framework, we synthesize over 400 works and summarize more than 100 representative systems spanning model-based reinforcement learning, video generation, web and GUI agents, multi-agent social simulation, and AI-driven scientific discovery. We analyze methods, failure modes, and evaluation practices across level-regime pairs, propose decision-centric evaluation principles and a minimal reproducible evaluation package, and outline architectural guidance, open problems, and governance challenges. The resulting roadmap connects previously isolated communities and charts a path from passive next-step prediction toward world models that can simulate, and ultimately reshape, the environments in which agents operate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个“Levels x Laws”分类法，将世界模型按能力层级（L1预测器、L2模拟器、L3进化器）和支配法则（物理、数字、社会、科学）两个维度分类，综述了400+文献和100+代表性系统，为AI世界模型研究提供路线图。
AI.motivation: AI系统从文本生成转向持续交互完成任务时，环境动态建模成为核心瓶颈。不同研究社区对“世界模型”定义不一，缺乏统一框架来理解、比较和评估各类世界模型，阻碍了跨领域进展。
AI.method: 提出“Levels x Laws”二维分类法。Levels维度：L1预测器（一步局部转移算子）、L2模拟器（多步动作条件rollout）、L3进化器（自主修订模型）。Laws维度：物理、数字、社会、科学法则。基于此框架综述400+文献，分析方法、失败模式、评估实践，提出决策中心评估原则和最小可复现评估包。
AI.result: 建立了统一的世界模型分类框架，覆盖模型基强化学习、视频生成、Web/GUI代理、多智能体社会模拟、AI驱动科学发现等领域。提出决策中心评估原则和可复现评估包，识别了各层级-法则组合的方法、失败模式和开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 该路线图连接了此前孤立的社区，指明了从被动下一步预测向能模拟并最终重塑环境的主动世界模型发展的路径，并提出了架构指导、开放问题和治理挑战。
idea_en: A taxonomy-based unified evaluation framework for world models that classifies them along capability levels (L1 Predictor, L2 Simulator, L3 Evolver) and governing-law regimes (physical, digital, social, scientific), enabling cross-domain comparison and benchmarking.
A self-revising world model mechanism (L3 Evolver) that autonomously detects prediction failures against new evidence and revises its internal environment model without human intervention.
A decision-centric evaluation methodology for world models that measures performance based on downstream decision quality rather than prediction accuracy alone.
A minimal reproducible evaluation package for world models that standardizes testing across different law regimes and capability levels.
An architecture for multi-step action-conditioned rollout simulators (L2 Simulator) that compose one-step transition operators while respecting domain-specific governing laws.
A cross-regime world model transfer method that adapts environment dynamics learned in one law regime (e.g., physical) to another (e.g., digital) through latent space alignment.
idea_ch: 一种基于分类法的世界模型统一评估框架，按能力层级（L1预测器、L2模拟器、L3进化器）和支配法则（物理、数字、社会、科学）分类，实现跨领域比较和基准测试
一种自修正世界模型机制（L3进化器），能自主检测预测失败并自动修订内部环境模型，无需人工干预
一种以决策为中心的评估方法，基于下游决策质量而非仅预测准确度来评估世界模型性能
一种最小可复现的世界模型评估包，标准化不同法则体系和能力层级下的测试
一种多步动作条件rollout模拟器（L2模拟器）架构，在遵守领域特定支配法则的前提下组合一步转移算子
一种跨法则体系的世界模型迁移方法，通过潜空间对齐将在一个法则体系（如物理）中学到的环境动态迁移到另一个体系（如数字）
